When at home, the Ice Cream Maker can be electric so nobody has to do any work to chill it.
When outdoors (like camping or picnics), there are also hand-crank Ice Cream Makers. But, you have to make sure they are constantly being cranked, so you'll want several people to take turns. &smiley;
Chilling time is less if you let it sit and cool for a while before putting in the Ice Cream Maker. If you double the recipe, you can fit it all into a 6-Quart Ice Cream Maker It is great by itself, but is a big kick if you serve it next to a hot dessert or if you serve it with toppings like fruit, chocolate syrup, caramel, etc.
